For example, the embeddings for "king" and "queen" will be close but distinct, reflecting their related meanings. This semantic encoding enables the model to generalize from seen to unseen data effectively. So, embeddings serve both to enable efficient computation and to provide meaningful representations that help the model grasp language intricacies. Next, we’ll explore how these embeddings interact within the model to generate coherent and contextually relevant text.
